change: Persist consented workshop inputs server-side and preprovision a canonical customer portal before account claim.
root_cause: The scan previously persisted only the no-PII aggregate scan event while richer participant/company context remained in browser state and a separate lead route, so a later portal session could lose the data or require re-entry.
prevention_rule: Every consented workshop scan must persist the canonical scan, store portal PII in a private service-only intake, create canonical-brain portal state keyed by the same submission_key, and transfer that state to the authenticated tenant on claim. PII must never enter aggregate benchmark/growth learning.

evidence.privacy: workshop_portal_intakes service-role only; aggregate scan/growth events remain no-PII
